units: subject x session (sub-E3b = English subject 3 session 2 is its own unit S003_ses2)

preprocessing.tsss: Maxwell filtering in the validation only (standardised data are raw): bads = FIF info bads (Russian, kept from the source) + find_bad_channels_maxwell on the first 120 s of each trial; maxwell_filter with the site fine-calibration and cross-talk files from the download (en: sss_cal_triux.dat, ct_sparse_triux.fif; ru: sss_cal_vectorview.dat, ct_sparse_vectorview.fif), tSSS st_duration 10 s, origin fitted to the head shape, head frame, no movement compensation; magnetometers after SSS. No cHPI removal and no notch (see chpi)
preprocessing.raw: standardised data as stored (no SSS), magnetometers (Russian FIF bads not excluded)

backward.method: LOTO (all of the unit's trials) ridge backward decoder, 102 magnetometers, lags 0-250 ms, lambda 0.1 x mean eigenvalue, 64 Hz, 0.5-8 Hz; nulls per held-out trial: 50 circular shifts (>= 5 s) and the other trials' envelopes (mismatch, np.resize; same stimulus in every trial, so the mismatch null here is the same envelope from another presentation: NOT a valid null for this dataset, see note); subject null = 2000 draws of one null value per trial; lag sweep +-1 s in 15.6 ms steps (positive = stimulus delayed), parabolic peak, subject bootstrap CI; tolerance 1 sample (15.6 ms)

latency_trf.method: forward TRF Hilbert envelope -> 102 magnetometers, 128 Hz, 1-15 Hz, lags -200..600 ms, ridge alpha 1; GFP per unit, mean over units; M50 = GFP max 30-80 ms, M100 = GFP max 80-160 ms (highest local maximum in the window; None if none)
